chunks: From him, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pronounced five takbirs.
ai.seo_question: How many takbirs did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pronounce in the prayer over the dead?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم pronounced five takbirs. It is relevant to the rulings concerning the funeral prayer over the dead and serves as evidence for the number of takbirs in that act of worship.
